That sounds *wonderful*! Honestly, it's fantastic that you prioritize that little ritual for yourself. It's so much more than just "doing your makeup." You're right, taking the time to carefully blend and perfect details like eyeliner is a form of self-care. 

It's completely valid and beneficial to have routines that make you feel put-together and ready to face the day. It sets a positive tone and can really boost your confidence. Don't let anyone make you feel like it's frivolous or a waste of time – if it makes *you* feel good, that's all that matters!

It's great you've identified that it's not just about the *look* of the makeup, but the *process* itself that's important to you. Keep enjoying that peaceful, focused time in the morning! ✨
